Role Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will transform raw data into actionable insights, supporting day-to-day data operations and executive reporting. Database Management &
SQL:



Write, run, and optimize SQL queries to extract, aggregate, and clean data from relational databases.





Dashboarding &
BI:



Design and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.



Operational Analysis:



Analyze operational datasets - including call logs, messaging interaction volumes - to ensure accurate reporting and track usage trends.





Ad-Hoc Analysis:



Conduct quick, data-driven deep dives using Advanced Excel (PivotTables, Power Query, complex formulas) to resolve immediate operational queries.





Data Quality &
Collaboration:

Power BI: Hands-on experience building reports, managing relationships in data models, and writing basic DAX measures.


Excel: Advanced proficiency in Excel (XLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, PivotTables, formatting, data manipulation).


Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with a high attention to detail.

jobs_results.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Orange Business is hiring a Junior Data Analyst in Faridabad. This is a full-time, permanent role for candidates who want to work on real data analytics problems — owning datasets, numbers and reporting that the business actually makes decisions on, not practice exercises.

About the role
In this Junior Data Analyst position you will be trusted with real business questions. Day to day that means supporting senior analysts on recurring reports, data validation and first-pass analysis with SQL, Excel and Power BI, and holding a high bar on data quality, documentation and clarity of communication.

Key responsibilities
• Prepare and clean datasets for the analytics team under a senior analyst
• Build simple dashboards and recurring reports, reviewed before release
• Run first-pass analyses and summarise what the data shows
• Cross-check published numbers against source systems
• Document your queries and steps so the work is repeatable
• Validate and reconcile numbers before they are published, and document known data caveats
• Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on analysis rather than refreshes
• Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, plain language

Required skills and tools
• SQL
• Advanced Excel
• Power BI
• Tableau
• Python (Pandas)
• Data Cleaning
• Data Visualization
• Descriptive Statistics
• Dashboarding
• Business Acumen
• Stakeholder Communication
• Documentation

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), B.Com, BBA or MBA. Candidates from any recognised university are welcome.
• Graduation year: 2023–2026 batches. Freshers and final-year students awaiting results may apply.
• Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA in the highest qualification (indicative — strong practical skills can offset this).
• Experience: 0–2 years in analytics, reporting, MIS or a closely related function.
• Technical skills: SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning.
• Soft skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, stakeholder communication, ownership and the confidence to flag a number that looks wrong.

Salary and compensation
• Annual CTC: ₹2,80,000 – ₹5,20,000 per year (2.8 LPA – 5.2 LPA), an indicative market range for this role in Faridabad.
• Monthly equivalent: approximately ₹33,000 per month at the mid-point of the range.
• Currency: INR (₹).
• Performance bonus / variable pay as per Orange Business's policy, reviewed annually.
• The exact offer is confirmed by Orange Business based on your interview performance and current compensation.

Perks and benefits
• Team offsites and networking opportunities
• Competitive salary as per market benchmarks
• Annual performance bonus / variable pay
• Health insurance for you and your dependants
• Provident Fund and statutory benefits
• Structured onboarding and mentorship
• Learning & certification support (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, cloud)
• Paid leaves and public holidays

Location, work mode and employment type
• Location: Faridabad, Haryana
• Work mode: Work From Office
• Employment type: Full-time, permanent
• Working hours: Standard business hours, Monday to Friday (5-day week)
• Number of openings: 4
• Joining: immediate to 60 days, as per your notice period

Selection process
• Round 1 — Resume screening and profile shortlisting by the talent acquisition team
• Round 2 — Hiring manager discussion — role expectations, ownership and team fit
• Round 3 — Online assessment — SQL, Excel and quantitative aptitude
• Round 4 — Technical interview 1 — SQL joins, aggregations, window functions and data modelling
• Round 5 — HR discussion — compensation, notice period, joining date and offer roll-out

Who should apply
Candidates from B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), B.Com, BBA or MBA with up to 2 years of relevant experience who are based in Faridabad or willing to relocate. You should be comfortable with SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI and able to explain your analysis to someone who has never seen the data. Portfolio projects, Kaggle work, a GitHub repo or published dashboards strengthen an application, especially for early-career candidates.

Why join Orange Business
At Orange Business the analytics function is treated as core, not a back-office service. You will have direct access to stakeholders, room to challenge assumptions and support to keep learning. There is a clear progression path from Analyst to Senior Analyst, and onward into analytics leadership or a specialist data-science / data-engineering track. You will leave every year of this role with ownership of a recurring report and an analysis a manager acted on.

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not signed in you will be asked to log in or create a free MyInternships.in candidate account first, after which you will be taken directly to Orange Business's official careers page to submit your application. Applications close on 26 October 2026 and are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Additional information
• Documents required at the interview stage: updated resume, degree certificates or provisional certificate, and government photo ID.
• Experienced candidates should also carry recent payslips and a relieving or experience letter.
• There is no service bond for this position, and no equipment deposit is taken.
• A laptop and licensed analytics tooling are provided by Orange Business for office and hybrid roles.
• Orange Business and MyInternships.in never charge a fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. If anyone asks you for money in the name of this job, do not pay — report it. Requirements: B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), B.Com, BBA or MBA from a recognised university; 0–2 years of experience in analytics, reporting or MIS — freshers and 2026 graduates are welcome; Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI; Comfort with SQL, Excel and Power BI and with cleaning messy, real-world data; Ability to define a metric precisely and explain a result to a non-technical stakeholder; Attention to detail, ownership and the discipline to document your work; Based in Faridabad, Haryana or willing to relocate.

jobs_results.title: Junior Business Analyst
jobs_results.description:
At Optimum Info, we are continually innovating and developing a range of software solutions empowering the Network Development and Field Operations businesses in the Automotive, Power Sports and Equipment industries. Our integrated suite of comprehensive solutions provides a seamless and rich experience to our customers, helping them become more effective at their work and create an impact on the organization.




Our sharp cultural focus on outstanding customer service and employee empowerment is core to our growth and success. As a growing company, we offer incredible opportunities for learning and growth with opportunity to manage high-impact business solution.


Position Overview
The Junior Analyst will acquire subject matter expertise on Optimum’s products and work as a liaison between Optimum’s account managers and the solutions delivery teams. This role will have key participation in the implementation of products for new accounts as well as the development of new features in various product lines across our network development solutions. The responsibility will span Optimum’s global accounts. The job will be based in Noida, India.


Key Responsibilities
Acquire a deep understanding of the assigned Optimum product line.
Work closely with our account managers in understanding feature requests and analyzing the impact on existing features.
Develop requirement specifications and acceptance tests for customer-specific features and functionality, including dashboards, reports, and other business requirements.
Coordinate with the engineering teams on new system functionality.
Test new features and reports before & after system deployments.
Support customer implementations of products by updating configurations, creating ad-hoc reports, providing guidance to users etc.
Create documentation for users to help them effectively use Optimum’s solutions. Our systems are used by Corporate, Field and Dealer users.
Analyze user actions and generate metrics on product usage, use the metrics to identify user training needs or propose new features in the product lines.
Desired qualifications and experience
Bachelor’s degree in any stream with experience in:
Collaborating with customer-facing and technical teams, analyzing impact of changes and new features; and creating requirement specifications.
Creating test cases for documented requirements and conducting testing to validate developed features.
Work experience of 1-2 years with at least 0.5 years as a business analyst.
Excellent verbal and written
